_doc: Tools outside conda (FEUILLE_DE_ROUTE_ATELIER.md §8.2): official URL, SHA256 checked before use, licence. 'archive': zip | 7z | inno | file ('inno': an Inno Setup installer, unpacked with innoextract and never run; 'file': the download itself is copied to dest/bin; several 'file' entries may share one dest, archive entries own theirs). 'bin': path of the main executable inside the extracted folder. 'sha_source': where the SHA256 comes from. 'optional': a rolling upstream build; if its pin no longer matches, the installer reports it and goes on. Never redistributed: downloaded from the publisher.
